description:
Some days you don't want to type. You just want to talk.

So open the notebook and speak. Your voice is transcribed into a private diary you can flip through, page by page — like a real hardcover journal that actually listens.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

• Talk, don't type — Record your day in your own voice. Speech turns into text automatically, so you capture how you really feel, not just what's quick to thumb-type.

• A real notebook feel — Hand-crafted paper textures, warm serif type, and page-flip navigation. Calm and tactile — nothing like a sterile notes app.

• Private by design — Mood and emotion analysis runs entirely on your iPhone. Your entries never leave your device unless you turn on iCloud backup.

• Understand your moods — See emotion trends and keyword highlights over time, plus AI weekly and monthly recaps that sum up how you've really been.

• Gentle daily prompts — Never face a blank page. Thoughtful prompts help you start, reflect, and keep going.

• Build a streak — Small nudges turn journaling into a daily habit you look forward to.

• Lock it down — Protect your diary with Face ID. Free, always.

FREE & PRO

Journaling, mood insights, daily prompts, and Face ID lock are free. Pro unlocks unlimited voice transcription, iCloud sync across devices, AI summaries, all themes
and fonts, more photos per entry, and PDF export.

Pro is a monthly or annual subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purcwith a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account.Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in your App Store settings.
